description: Define a zoning overlay region on the city map. Mayor-only. Updates /home/baron/projects/freeso-civic/zoning.json (shared across all sidecars). The purchase-lot handler checks this file: if the target tile falls within a zone, the purchased lot type must match the zone type or the purchase is refused with ZONING_VIOLATION. Zone types: residential, commercial, park.

args.name: zone_type
args.description: Zone type: 'residential', 'commercial', or 'park'. A purchase-lot call into a residential zone may only create residential lots; commercial only commercial lots; park prohibits all lot purchases.

args.name: x1
args.description: Left boundary of the zone bounding box (inclusive). X coordinate in city-tile units (same as lot X from MapCoordinates.Pack).

args.name: y1
args.description: Top boundary of the zone bounding box (inclusive).

args.name: x2
args.description: Right boundary of the zone bounding box (inclusive). Must be >= x1.

args.name: y2
args.description: Bottom boundary of the zone bounding box (inclusive). Must be >= y1.

args.name: zone_name
args.description: Optional human-readable name for this zone (e.g. 'Downtown District'). Informational only.

common_mistakes: Only the mayor can set zoning — non-mayor gets NO_AUTH.
zone_type must be exactly 'residential', 'commercial', or 'park' — INVALID_ZONE_TYPE otherwise.
x2 must be >= x1 and y2 must be >= y1 — INVALID_BOUNDS otherwise.
Zones are additive — each set-zoning call adds a new region; it does not replace existing ones.
purchase-lot calls into a park zone are refused unconditionally (no lot type matches park).
The zoning file is written to /home/baron/projects/freeso-civic/zoning.json — all sidecars read it at startup and on each purchase-lot call.
refuse_conditions: Caller is not the mayor → NO_AUTH
zone_type not in {residential, commercial, park} → INVALID_ZONE_TYPE
x2 < x1 or y2 < y1 → INVALID_BOUNDS
perception_hints: City coordinates: same X/Y as lot coordinates in MapCoordinates.Pack(x,y) = x<<16|y
